verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is a hardware AI accelerator that is driven through software stacks such as PyTorch, DeepSpeed and vLLM. It has no user-facing UI whose features an API would need to match. Asking for API-vs-UI parity is therefore a category error for this type of product. The OpenAPI probe 404s simply confirm there is no web-service API surface to compare against a UI.
